c74object.name: j.ui
c74object.description: j.ui shows the address of the model of its patcher (or of the model a j.view in it is bound to), a menu of what is below the model, and its presets. A click on the address opens the menu of parameters, messages and returns; the menu arrow opens the utilities and presets menu. If the model has the parameter data/active, a round button next to the menu arrow shows whether the model is active (filled) or not (a ring), and a click on it switches the model. While there is no model it says that it is waiting for one.

method.name: active
method.digest: Switch the model on or off
method.description: Sets the parameter data/active of the model (the data amenity) to 1 or 0, as a click on the active button does; without an argument it switches to the other state. Nothing happens if the model has no such parameter.

method.name: dump
method.description: The dump message answers model:address and the address (or model:waiting), preset:count and the number of presets, presets and their names and preset:current and the current preset, out the outlet. If the model has the parameter data/active, active and 0 or 1 follow the address.

method.name: paint
method.description: Sent by Max when the panel is drawn.

method.name: mouseup
method.description: A click on the header opens the menu of nodes (on the address) or the utilities and presets menu (on the arrow).

attribute.name: bgcolor
attribute.description: The color of the background. At its default it is automatic: a faint grey tint that lets the patcher show through. A color you set is used as it is; the attribute name without values gives the default back (this holds for all the colors).

attribute.name: bordercolor
attribute.description: The color of the border. At its default it is automatic: a translucent grey.

attribute.name: headercolor
attribute.description: The color of the header. At its default it is automatic: the panel, as seen on the patcher, darkened until the header stands out (or lightened on a black background).

attribute.name: textcolor
attribute.description: The color of the title. At its default it is automatic: the text color of the patcher, or black or white if that is hard to read on the header.

attribute.name: highlightcolor
attribute.description: The color of the lit active button. At its default it is automatic: the color live_value_bar of the Max theme, or the color of the title if that is hard to see on the header.

attribute.name: snap
attribute.digest: Snap the size to the grid
attribute.description: When on (the default), the size of the object snaps to a whole number of units, 150 pixels wide and 35 pixels high, with at least one unit in each direction, as in the old version. When off, the object can have any size.

attribute.name: tags
attribute.description: Accepted so that old patchers load; it has no effect yet.
